plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 5th house: heat, chemistry, pursuit, sexual charge. Physical and exciting. Failure mode: drama for its own sake, or the chase being the only thing there. Keep it playful, not combative; see what's underneath the heat.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
